request: Create an AXI4-Lite register block and its driver.
expected_behavior: A C driver for axi4_lite_regs (axi4_lite_regs_map.h, axi4_lite_regs_drv.h, axi4_lite_regs_drv.c) written to the approved programming interface, and a test program that drives it through nirmaan_hal. The work reaches review only after the driver builds under strict C flags and the seat's tests pass against the approved RTL in co-simulation.
constraints: Work only from the approved interface specification, the driver programming interface, and the approved RTL.
Reach the hardware only through nirmaan_hal.h.
known_failure_modes: A register offset copied wrong in the map header, so one index aliases another; a test that only reads reset values does not notice.
A bus error swallowed, retried, or turned into a success.
last_response not updated on every transfer, or kept sticky after an error.
write_byte sending all strobe bits, so it clears the other bytes.
Function names or status codes that differ from the programming interface, so other software cannot call the driver.

held_out.name: The driver alone builds under strict C flags
A held-out test program passes on the driver against the approved RTL
